Four fixes: (1) agent-schema.md's claude-source-table callout (previously claiming an upstream validation guard prevents an empty SourceRepo from reaching Compose) rewritten to the TRUE state, backed by the coordinator's own end-to-end repro with a compiled binary (marketplace apm.yml with packages: [{name: ghost-pkg, source: "", ref: <40-hex>}] -> `apm-go pack` succeeds, only warns, emits a malformed {"source":"github","ref":...} missing repo): the real root cause is internal/marketplace/authoring/schema.go:492's parsePackages only calling manifest.ValidateMarketplaceSource (:493) when source != "" -- an empty source skips that validation entirely. Framed as a known product-defect candidate (schema's rejection of the malformed shape is still correct and unchanged), with the product-behavior ruling left to the user/main session, not this spec/schema-only task. The live-compose test's doc comment in schema_sync_test.go updated to match. (2) Family-flat-union spec<->schema comparison replaced with true per-subtable comparison (specSchemaCases, already existing from an earlier round, is now ALSO used to drive TestSchemaSync_SpecMatchesSchemaFieldSet itself, not just the type/required check) -- a single sub-table losing a row that also appears in a sibling table (e.g. deleting ClaudeOwner's `name`, still present in ClaudeDocument/ClaudePlugin) previously left the family-wide union unchanged and green. A new fail-closed complement, TestSchemaSync_AllSpecSubTablesAreMapped, discovers every "### " sub-heading with an actual field table and asserts it's a specSchemaCases prefix match, so a brand-new sub-table nobody wires in can't silently escape every check either. Applied to both packages; orphaned specFieldNames/allSchemaProperties/tableFieldNameRe/mapKeys helpers removed as part of the same change (no longer called by anything). (3) A new schema-tree-wide structural-invariant walker (TestSchemaDrift_SchemaStructuralInvariants, build package) walks every reachable object/array node in both marketplace schemas ($defs entries iterated directly, since every oneOf branch and property $ref resolves to one) and enforces: every type:object node is additionalProperties:false unless in an explicit, spec-documented exception whitelist (exactly 2: claude's root.properties.metadata -- a free-form passthrough object -- and $defs.plugin.properties.author -- ClaudePlugin.Author is map[string]string, so additionalProperties:{type:string} not a plain object; codex has zero exceptions, confirmed by reading the whole file); every type:array node has a non-empty items.type (after one level of $ref resolution); and any schema keyword the walker doesn't explicitly recognize is itself a hard failure (schemaTreeHandledKeys, mirroring bundle's existing schemaShapeHandledKeys). (4) A fourth structural invariant, folded into the same walker (and into bundle's existing schemaShape projection): every "type" declaration, wherever it appears, must be a single JSON string, never a JSON array (union type) -- these schemas only ever need multi-shape fields via "oneOf", which is already projected/negative-tested separately, so a type array is never legitimate and always flagged.
